The ordering Yuva, then Kumara, then Bala and Vriddha, then Mrita is the classical convention. The numeric factors are the engine author's reading and are NOT in the attached rule library, so they are open for the owner to correct. In odd signs the bands run Bala 0 to 6, Kumara 6 to 12, Yuva 12 to 18, Vriddha 18 to 24, Mrita 24 to 30. In even signs the order is reversed. Odd signs are Aries, Gemini, Leo, Libra, Sagittarius, Aquarius.
